title: The progressive seeding error is spelled "progessive"
body:
`seed` in `nail/src/search.rs` wraps a failed `--seed-mode prog` run with the context `progessive seeding failed`. The word is missing an r. The user sees it as the first line of the error.

## Proposal

Spell it `progressive`.
close_reason: The context in seed() in nail/src/search.rs reads progressive. Committed on dev.
